top_signals.title: Dated Brent Above $120 Signals a Serious Oil Squeeze
top_signals.summary: Physical oil markets tighten sharply as Dated Brent surges above $120 despite ICE Brent slipping toward $101. Friday, October 02, 2026 The European diesel stock release, droned tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and China reinstating its refined product export ban have all played their part in this week’s extremely volatile trading, with ICE Brent edging lower to $101 per barrel. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Paradigm-backed Layer 2 Blast to wind down network as costs exceed revenue
top_signals.summary: Ethereum L2 Blast is winding down after costs outpaced revenue. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw via the app.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
